utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried we might be short on time and supplies, but I can come by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Come by after lunch, and tell me what supplies you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’ll come by after lunch and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they’re still signing folks up this afternoon, so it’s worth swinging by before it wraps up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh good, then I’ll tell a few more people and swing by after lunch with coffee if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect, I’ll keep an ear out for who’s bringing tools and I’ll let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that would be great. I can come by too, and just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great, Nell. If you can bring any basic repair supplies like tape, screws, or tools, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing, I can bring some tape, screws, and a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep you posted and make sure the others hear about it too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me. Keep me in the loop and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the others in the loop and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s the repair drive for 1423 Maple Street, and the driveway’s already flagged for the team.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Has the team already started, or is it still being put together?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira, I’ve got the repair drive details ready. I’ll send you the list of needed items and drop-off time, and you can bring whatever fits best.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa. Just send the list and I’ll stop by if I can make it before it ends.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Kira. I’ll send the list and drop-off time now, and if you make it before we wrap up, just bring what works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I know where it starts, by the old post office. I can walk you there if you need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works, thanks. Let’s start at the old post office and check the drive from there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, let’s head there and start from the old post office.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’m checking the school schedule now so we can fit the repair drive in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already start, or are you still putting it together?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet - I’m still putting it together after checking the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I heard it’s moving along, but I’m still fuzzy on the details. What’s the latest from Opal?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s 1423 Maple Street, and I’ve got the driveway flagged for the repair team.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that helps — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I’ve got the address now. Who’s handling the actual repair team?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I can take a look. Tell me what’s acting up on the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, just checking that the repair drive still needs attention on my end too. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It still needs attention on my end, and I’m waiting on the symptom so I can tell you the latest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that—what kind of repair items do you still need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I still need screws, wood glue, and a spare hinge if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a pry bar if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That should help. I just need the drive itself right now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll head over with the drive now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on it. I’ll keep the others in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Vik. I’ll update the group and line up the next steps for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the others posted and make sure the repair drive stays moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I know the repair drive starts by the old post office. I can walk you there if you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. I’m mostly worried we’ll be short on supplies, though.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with that. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I need to keep it light today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that, and I’ll keep it light too. Just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d appreciate that. Maybe just a box of gloves and a simple lunch, nothing heavy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I heard it’s moving along, but I still need the details from someone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I heard that too. I just need the specifics before I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What’s the symptom - no spin, noise, or it’s not reading the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No spin, just to narrow it down. The drive isn’t being read at all.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll check the drive’s read path and clean the contacts first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that too. What kind of repair items do you still need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I still need the specific parts for the drive, like whatever’s worn or not working right.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that. Tell me which parts are worn out or acting up, and I’ll see what we can round up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a pry bar if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would help a lot, Gus. Do you also have any screws or wood glue for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got some screws in the garage, and I can check for wood glue too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey said he can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet - are you still putting it together, or should I start asking people what they can bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still putting it together. Go ahead and start asking folks what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s 1423 Maple Street by the old post office, and I’ve got the driveway flagged for the repair team.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — that’s the place. I’ll swing by this afternoon and see who’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon. If anyone needs a hand, I’m right by the old post office.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, just keep me posted when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word. I can stop by after lunch and point you the right way too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Just the drive itself. I need to check the belt and clean out the contacts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the drive, but I need to keep it light today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It covers the labor, basic parts, and a quick checkup. If you want, I can list the exact items too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
